title: Miss probability for a nonzero polynomial
statement: Let $n,\ell,m\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $P$ be a nonzero polynomial over $\mathbb{F}_2$ expressed as an algebraic normal form using monomials indexed by subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$. For $m$ independent uniformly sampled points of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the probability that $P$ vanishes at every sampled point is at most $\exp\!\left(-m(1/2)^\ell\right)$.
